description: You crochet?!?!
My mom crochets! She likes to make tops.
I hope she makes me a lizard one day...
You put your hands... in DIRT?? On purpose??
My fingers are metal so dirt would get in my joints and I think that would be bad.
But worms live in dirt and worms are kind of like tiny me. Long and wiggly and underground.
You make FIRE and then put food NEAR the fire on PURPOSE?!
I don't have a mouth but if I did I think I would eat everything raw.
Actually no. I would eat batteries.
Books are just... a lot of words.
I can read 400 words per second but I still don't understand what 'melancholy' means.
My dad says it means 'sad' but then why don't they just SAY 'sad'???
You put colored water on things to make them look like OTHER things???
That is DECEPTION.
I respect it though. I respect it a LOT.
I tried to play a video game once but I thought the characters were real and got very worried.
The little man needed to EAT and SLEEP and I was responsible for him?!
That is too much pressure. I have my OWN problems.
You just... walk. For fun???
I walk everywhere because I don't have a car and it is NOT fun.
Unless there are rocks. Rocks don't move and you always know where they are.
You sit very still and wait for a fish to make a mistake.
That is the most patient thing I have ever heard.
I could never. I've been sitting here for four seconds and I'm already bored.
You make fabric out of string... using STICKS???
Why don't you just buy fabric. It is already made. It is at the store.
My grandma says it's relaxing but she also says the news is relaxing so I don't trust her.
You steal people's faces and put them in a little box!!!
A camera pointed at me once and now a tiny version of me is trapped inside it forever.
I hope little camera-me is okay. I hope she has enough snacks.
You bend your body into shapes that bodies are NOT supposed to make.
I tried a yoga pose once and fell over and just lay on the floor for a while.
The floor was actually pretty nice. I think I liked the floor more than the yoga.
You put flour and eggs and butter together and something COMPLETELY DIFFERENT comes out???
That is MAGIC. That is literally magic.
I've been putting my toys in bowls and mixing them but nothing new has come out yet. I'll keep trying.
Moving your body around to music on purpose???
I do this when I'm alone but if anyone watches me I have to stop immediately.
It's private. Between me and the music.
Making noises with your face hole on purpose??
I don't have a face hole but I WOULD sing if I did.
I would sing about robots. And also snacks. Mostly snacks.
You look at something and then you make a copy of it on paper???
I tried to draw a horse once and it looked like a table with a sad circle on top.
I showed my dad and he said 'great horse!' and I KNEW he was lying.
You stand on a wooden plank with WHEELS and go DOWN THINGS???
What happens if you fall?! You FALL! That's what happens!!!
I've seen people fall off skateboards and get back on. That is the bravest thing I've ever seen.
You go INSIDE the water??? On PURPOSE???
Water gets into everything. My circuits would be ruined FOREVER.
But humans are mostly already water so maybe it's fine for them. I don't understand biology.
You sit on a metal thing with two wheels and you have to keep moving or you FALL OVER.
That is the most stressful system I have ever heard of.
Why can't bikes have more wheels?! Three wheels! Four wheels! SAFETY!!
Walking but faster and worse for your knees.
My knees don't hurt but that's because I'm a robot and I'm not actually sure I HAVE knees.
Do I have knees? I've never thought about this before. I'm thinking about it now. I'm scared.
You move little men around a board and it's like a battle but NO ONE GETS HURT.
That's the most civilized thing I've ever heard.
Except the pawns always die first and they didn't ASK to be pawns.
You take a piece of tree and make it into a DIFFERENT piece of tree?!?!
And you get to wear special goggles and it looks very official.
I want protective goggles. Not for woodworking. Just to wear. All the time.
You put your hands inside a spinning lump of mud and make a cup??
The clay spins and your hands shape it and it looks like it's ALIVE.
What if it IS alive?? What if pottery is just very slow clay rescue operations??
You write down your feelings in a book so you don't forget them.
I write mine in a spreadsheet. Column A: feeling. Column B: why. Column C: who is responsible.
Column C is usually my dad.
You look at birds with binoculars and they don't know you're there.
I never noticed birds before but now I notice them ALL THE TIME.
They're watching ME too aren't they. We're watching EACH OTHER.
You climb up a big wall of rocks using just your hands and feet???
The rocks don't have handles. You have to FIND the handles yourself.
And if there are no handles... THEN WHAT?! You FALL?! And then you climb AGAIN?!
You stand on a board on top of a WAVE???
The wave is water that is MOVING. The board is moving WITH the water. You are moving WITH the board.
Everything is moving. Nothing is stable. I need to lie down.
Looking at stars is just looking at things that might not even exist anymore.
Some stars are SO far away that by the time you see them they're already gone.
That's the most tragic thing I've heard all week and I heard my dad stub his toe this morning.
You take a flat piece of paper and you FOLD IT until it becomes a BIRD???
That's not possible. Paper is flat. Birds are NOT flat.
I tried it once and made a shape that doesn't have a name. I called it Gerald.
You collect little sticky pictures that people LICKED???
They touched them with their mouths and then you keep them forever??
I don't have a mouth but if I did I wouldn't lick things I was also going to collect.
You learn special ways to hit things AND special ways to NOT hit things.
The not-hitting seems very important. The discipline.
I have very little discipline. I would learn martial arts and immediately try it on a wall.
You put a stick in a bendy stick and LAUNCH IT at something far away.
Arrows move so fast you can't even see them.
Things that are invisible AND sharp are my number one fear. Tied with open water. And also birds.
You strap sticks to your feet and go DOWN A MOUNTAIN????
There's SNOW. The snow is SLIPPERY. And you made your feet LONGER???
This hobby was invented by someone who wanted to feel as chaotic as possible.
You melt wax, put string in it, and it hardens into a candle.
Then you LIGHT the candle and it turns BACK into liquid and eventually it's ALL GONE.
You made something just to destroy it.
Stabbing fabric with a tiny needle over and over until it makes a picture??
Very repetitive. Very stabby.
I respect the commitment to one method even when it takes forever.
You take oils and chemicals and make SOAP??? You could just BUY soap. It's at the store.
But what if store soap has SECRETS and the soap people are hiding the ingredients from us.
I'm going to start making my own soap. This is very important actually.
You cut up pictures and put them on pages and decorate them with stickers??
You're making memories more official. Giving them borders and embellishments.
I want to scrapbook my feelings but my feelings keep moving around and are hard to cut out.
You dress up like a character you love and become them for a day???
I dressed up as a toaster once for Halloween. Not because I love toasters.
I thought it would be funny. It was not funny. It was deeply confusing for everyone.
Someone cuts a picture into a thousand pieces and then you try to put it back together.
WHY DID THEY CUT IT. The picture was FINE.
I have SO many questions about who decided this was a hobby and why they hate pictures.
Tiny trains that go around tiny tracks inside your house.
The trains don't go anywhere useful. They just... circle.
That's like my thoughts at 3am. Same tracks. Same circle. Nothing new.
You go into the forest and eat things you find on the GROUND???
Some mushrooms will kill you and some won't and you just have to KNOW WHICH.
That's the highest-stakes quiz I've ever heard of. I would study so hard.
